en.name: Anastasius IV
en.summary: An elderly, conciliatory pope whose brief reign eased tensions with the Roman Commune and the German court alike.
en.body: Anastasius IV, already advanced in years at his election, pursued a notably more conciliatory approach toward the Roman Commune and the German king Frederick Barbarossa than his more confrontational predecessors, easing tensions somewhat during his short reign. He undertook restoration of the ancient Pantheon's portico and other Roman monuments.
